list_models.description: List models served by GUFO through the masquerade shim.

loaded_models.description: List models resident in memory (shim synthesises status.value; GUFO emits none).

pull_model.description: Provision a model. GUFO compiles its model graph and loads weights at process start and cannot download over HTTP: the shim acks immediately for a model GUFO already serves, else returns 501 with instructions. To change the served model: stage weights, then `gufo-pairctl restart`. Set SHIM_PULL_POLICY=fake for a simulated download when testing the UI.

load_model.description: Load a model into memory. GUFO pre-loads its single model at startup, so this is an idempotent ack for a resident model and 404 for anything else.

unload_model.description: Unload a model. Cancelling an in-flight pull succeeds. Unloading the actively-served model returns 409 rather than falsely claiming eviction, because GUFO cannot evict at runtime; stop the pod to unload. SHIM_REFUSE_UNLOAD_SERVING=0 makes it a documented no-op ack.

delete_model.description: Remove a model from the shim's advertised inventory. Weights on disk are untouched (GUFO has no delete primitive); the model simply stops being listed and routed, and the deletion survives shim restarts.
